title: Residential Painting in Williston, FL | Home Painters
description: Residential painting in Williston, FL for older downtown homes, US-27 build-outs, and farmhouses. Inside and out, own crews, up to 10-year exterior warranty.
heroIntro: Whole-home painting for Williston houses, inside and out. We plan the prep around the age and setting of your home rather than a one-size checklist.

sections.h2: Three kinds of Williston homes, three different starting points
body: Residential painting in Williston, FL does not start from the same place every time. A home near the downtown core may carry several generations of paint, some of it failing at the edges. A newer house along US-27 usually has thin builder coatings over clean substrates. A farmhouse on an agricultural parcel tends to see more dust, splash-back, and hard use at the entries than a town lot. Our crew lead notes which situation you are in during the walkthrough and writes the prep around it.

sections.h2: Older homes: scraping back to something sound
body: On older siding and trim, new paint is only as good as the layer underneath. We scrape loose coating back to a tight edge, sand glossy spots so primer can bite, replace rotted trim and fascia instead of filling it, and spot-prime bare wood. Moisture readings come first wherever wood looks soft. If you suspect water behind the cladding, our article on hidden siding moisture damage explains what to look for.

sections.h2: Newer US-27 homes: the first real repaint
body: Builder paint does its job for the closing photos and not much longer. Interior flats scuff and will not wipe clean, and exterior colors start chalking on the sunny sides early. A first repaint is the moment to move to 100% acrylic on siding and trim and washable satin or eggshell indoors. On these homes the prep is usually lighter, so more of the budget goes into product.

sections.h2: How the estimate for a Williston house is put together
body: A crew lead, not a salesperson, comes out to measure, photograph each side of the house, and take moisture readings on any trim that looks suspect. The written quote usually arrives within one business day and breaks the job into surfaces: siding, trim, doors, soffits, each interior room. That makes it easy to start with the outside this season and finish the bedrooms later. You can read more about how we work across town on our Williston service area page.

sections.h2: Living at home while the work happens
body: You do not need to move out. Inside, crews protect and move furniture and work room by room, so most of the house stays usable each day. A single room usually takes a day, and a whole interior runs from three days to two weeks depending on size and repairs. A full exterior typically takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time.
For the broader picture of how we handle houses, see our residential painting service. If the exterior is the priority, our page on Williston exterior painting goes deeper into weather and products.

sections.h2: What the homeowner gets at the end
body: Close-out on a Williston home follows the same steps every time, whether the job was two rooms or the whole house.
bullets: A punch walk you sign, with anything not right fixed before close-out
Labelled touch-up paint for each color used
A written workmanship warranty, up to 10 years on exterior work
The manufacturer's product warranty on top of ours

faqs.q: Can you paint my Williston home inside and out in one project?
faqs.a: Yes. We often schedule the exterior during drier months and the interior rooms around it, all under a single written estimate with one crew lead.

faqs.q: Do you repair rotted trim on older Williston homes?
faqs.a: Rot and fascia replacement are part of our standard prep days. We would rather replace a soft board than paint over it and have it fail.

faqs.q: Do you paint the farmhouse and the barn on the same visit?
faqs.a: We can include outbuildings on the same estimate as the house. Each structure is itemized so you can see what it costs and decide what to include.
